Plot a Fitted gpAim Object

Source: R/plot.gpAim.R
plot.gpAim.Rd

Produces one of four diagnostic plots for a gpAim object, selected via the type argument.

"blups"

Genome-wide marker effect plot. Back-computed marker effect BLUPs \(\hat{q}\) are plotted as points across the genome using cumulative cM positions. For the mbf path, effects are the direct BLUP solutions; for the vm path they are back-computed as \(\hat{q} = T \hat{g}\), where \(T\) is the transformation matrix from constructCM and \(\hat{g}\) are the GEBVs. Requires the genObj used in the original gpAim() call.

"caterpillar" (default)

Ranked GEBV dot plot with half-HSD comparison bars for the top and bottom top.n lines. Half-HSD bars are defined as \(t_\alpha \times SE_i / \sqrt{2}\); two GEBVs whose half-HSD bars do not overlap are significantly different at level alpha. Bars are shown only for the extreme lines (near selection decisions) to preserve readability with many lines. Points are coloured by selection status relative to the threshold.

"heatmap"

Tile heatmap of the genomic relationship matrix \(G\), with lines ordered by Ward hierarchical clustering. Reveals population sub-structure, family groups, and potential duplicate lines. A warning is issued for datasets with more than 500 lines where rendering may be slow.

"density"

Density plot of the GEBV distribution with the selected region shaded, a threshold line, and annotation of the number selected, proportion selected, and selection differential (mean GEBV of selected minus mean of all).

Usage

# S3 method for class 'gpAim'
plot(
  x,
  genObj = NULL,
  type = c("caterpillar", "heatmap", "density", "blups"),
  alpha = 0.05,
  top.n = 20,
  threshold = NULL,
  prop.select = 0.1,
  pt.col = c("steelblue", "firebrick"),
  pt.cex = 0.8,
  ...
)

Arguments

x

A gpAim object.

genObj

The "wgCross" or "wgPanel" object passed to gpAim. Required only when type = "blups".

type

Character string specifying the plot type: "caterpillar" (default), "heatmap", "density", or "blups".

alpha

Numeric significance level used to compute half-HSD bar widths in the caterpillar plot. Default 0.05.

top.n

Integer. Number of highest- and lowest-ranked lines for which half-HSD bars are drawn in the caterpillar plot. Default 20. Reducing this value improves readability with very many lines.

threshold

Numeric. Selection threshold for caterpillar and density plots. If between 0 and 1 exclusive, treated as a quantile of the GEBV distribution (e.g. 0.9 selects the top 10%). If outside (0, 1), treated as a raw GEBV value. If NULL (default), prop.select is used instead.

prop.select

Numeric proportion of lines to select, used when threshold = NULL. Default 0.10 (top 10%).

pt.col

Character vector of length 2: pt.col[1] is used for selected lines / high relatedness / positive GEBVs; pt.col[2] for unselected lines / low relatedness / negative GEBVs. Default c("steelblue","firebrick").

pt.cex

Numeric point size. Default 0.8.

...

Currently unused.

Value

A ggplot object.

See also

gpAim, summary.gpAim, print.gpAim

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
plot(gp.fit)                          # caterpillar (default)
plot(gp.fit, type = "heatmap")
plot(gp.fit, type = "density", prop.select = 0.10)
plot(gp.fit, type = "blups", genObj = genoRxK)
} # }
